method: Human-readable visual inspection by the coding agent of rasterized SVGs and actual browser UI; automated text and XML checks reported separately. No claim of independent human expert approval.
findings: Convolution and vector residual main/skip paths are easier to follow; normalization type remains explicit. Vertical layout increases height and sometimes wire length.
Parent-before-child paint order restores nested frame titles previously hidden by opaque parent fill.
SameSource and TwoSources distinguish input provenance without family-name detection. Dependency-band labels still expose topological presentation rather than complete algorithm explanation.
Shared representative labels exact instance and shared parameters; multiple x interfaces and nested source wrappers remain visually redundant.

Default comparison formerly had 38 wires and 152 crossings after extraction exposed per-layer context uses. Generic serial-repeat boundary bundles reduce it to 13 wires and 1 crossing, retaining every original use.

Requested detailed/default comparison presets defer to the overview frontier. Representative comparison panels can still show a closed source layer; focused contract panels are needed for internal roles. This is a limitation, not complete paper-style detail.
UnknownFusion keeps the unresolved kernel; ConditionalResidual keeps both conditional inputs and joins without residual certification.
